_help: How Starling answers the Watcher (Void Compass). The Watcher is gloomy and brilliant, rather like Marvin the paranoid android, so many lines tease or comfort his misery. Only mood-suffixed keys, so a happy line never leaks into a bad mood (Infatuated and Upset have their own). Lines with mature:true need strong language switched on.
